---
title: "STA230 — Statistical Learning"
---

Welcome to the interactive learning companion for **STA230 Statistical Learning** at Göteborg University.

This site covers all three course blocks — with concept explanations, multiple-choice quizzes, and interactive R code you can run and modify directly in the browser.

## Course structure

| Block | Topics |
|-------|--------|
| **Foundations** | What is statistical learning? Bias-variance tradeoff, training vs test error, cross-validation |
| **Block 1: Regression** | OLS, variable selection, ridge regression, LASSO |
| **Block 2: Classification** | Logistic regression, LDA/kNN, decision trees, random forests, boosting, ROC/AUC |
| **Block 3: Unsupervised** | PCA, k-means clustering, hierarchical clustering |

## How to use this site

1. Read the **concept** section — short and focused
2. Answer the **quiz** — tests comprehension before you see code
3. Run and modify the **code** — the key learning step
4. Use the **Guided Practice** exercises with real datasets
5. Click **Mark as complete** when done — your progress is saved in the browser

::: {.callout-tip}
## Coding is the way to learn
The central principle of STA230: understanding comes from *doing*, not reading. Every section ends with hands-on exercises using real datasets (Hitters, NHANES, SWP_CTW).
:::
